newsitem.title: USA: David White Inc sale completed.
newsitem.headline: David White Inc sale completed.

text.p: David White Inc said Wednesday that Choucroute Partners LLC, completed its previously announced acquisition of David White Inc.
Choucroutte Partners is a limited liability company managed by Milwaukee businessman Robert Foote Jr.
David White had announced in early May that Choucroute Partners would acquire David White for a purchase price of approximately $6 million.

The acquisition was completed following approval by David White's shareholders at a meeting held today. As a result of the acquisition, Foote will operate David White, a manufacturer of optical and laser surveying instruments, the company said.
